name: Borage

companions.note: Repels tomato hornworm; strong pollinator attractor improves fruit set
Repels cabbage worms; predatory insects attracted to borage flowers patrol nearby brassicas
Complementary pest deterrence; borage fills the pollinator role garlic lacks

pnw_notes: Star-shaped blue flowers are edible — mild cucumber flavor, good in salads or frozen in ice cubes. Self-seeds so prolifically it effectively persists year to year: thin seedlings rather than replanting. Drought tolerant once established. Relatively short-lived as an individual plant but the colony self-sustains. Bees in particular are strongly attracted to the flowers.

planting_windows.notes: Direct sow after last frost; dislikes transplanting
Pick flowers continuously to extend bloom period; harvest in the morning
